newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerage shares up on Nomura news.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerage shares up on Nomura news.

text.p: Shares in the Japanese brokerage sector climbed on Wednesday morning, after Nomura Securities Co Ltd's president and 15 board members resigned on Tuesday to take responsibility for a racketeering scandal.
By 0036 GMT, Nomura's shares had risen 30 yen to 1,400, Nikko Securities Co Ltd 20 yen to 720, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd 10 yen to 370 and Daiwa Securities Co Ltd 25 yen to 870.
Nomura's trading volume of 3.686 million shares was the largest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
The news of Nomura's management reshuffle helped to ease worries about Japanese brokerages houses, which had been rekindled when Nomura's scandal broke out last month.
The current upturn in the Tokyo stock market also prompted market participants to expect better earnings at brokerage houses, traders said.
